attributes.text: Rough reflections and noble materials come together in perfect synergy to emphasise the dichotomy of humankind — an homage to all those who have inspired her, and all those who continue to be inspired by life itself.
Boky Hackel — born in Rheinfelden, Germany, on May 6, 1964, and raised in Costa Rica and Venezuela.

Holding to his appreciation of the human figure, Ward remains true to the representational quality and realistic proportions of traditional sculpture while continually finding new ways to comment on the human condition.
Boky Hackel has been sculpting for just over a decade. Initially learning under the guidance of Blake Ward, she quickly took the creative direction into her own hands.

Her artistry has evolved with her since birth, initially inspired by the wilderness that cradled her creative spirit in the depth of the Costa Rican jungle were nature and nurture became one. The sky was her first playground. Her. mother an accomplished feminist and acrobatic commercial pilot gave Boky a bird’s eye view of life that would later shape her perspective on the human experience which she has made her mission to share on a spiritual an emotional level through her creative endeavours.

From photography, film, poetry, music, conceptual art which all comes together in her sculptural body work which explores the mysteries of time and being through light, steel, poetry, bronze and gold. Rough reflections and noble materials come together in perfect synergy to emphasise the dichotomy of human kind. An Homage to all those who have inspired her and all those who continue to be inspired by life itself.

Relocates to Florence and joins l'Instituto per l'Arte ed il Restauro, Palazzo Spinelli. Joins the Old Master Paintings Restoration Program, simultaneously studying Antique's Trade and Marketing

Florida Atlantic University - Bachelor in Music ; Honors Program in Composition and Historical Musicology from the Dorothy F. Schmidt College of Arts and Letters. Graduating summa cum laude, Phi Kappa Phi Honors society and National Dean's List.
Moves to Monaco - Pocock and Pocock Antiques, Maison d'art and MDA Today
